facts.claim: In Q2 2026, Amorepacific Corp. (operating company, consolidated) booked revenue of ₩1.1759tn (+17.0% YoY) and operating profit of ₩117.3bn (+59.3% YoY), per its preliminary disclosure of July 30.
In Q2 2026, Amorepacific Holdings (group consolidated, a different basis from the operating company) reported revenue of ₩1.2543tn (+14.6% YoY) and operating profit of ₩122.8bn (+53.3% YoY).

In Q2 2026, Amorepacific's overseas business grew revenue 28% and operating profit 99% YoY. Reported figures are ₩551.6bn revenue and ₩71.8bn OP, and overseas posted double-digit operating margins in both Q1 and Q2.
In Q2 2026, Amorepacific's domestic revenue rose 10% and domestic OP rose 48% YoY, putting the domestic operating margin at about 10%. Online and MBS channels each grew by double digits.

BNK Investment & Securities kept a Buy rating and raised its Amorepacific target price to ₩165,000. It put overseas OP at ₩71.8bn (+99.4% YoY, 13.0% margin), but expects ad and promotion spending to limit operating leverage through 2027.

At Amazon Prime Day 2026 (June 23–26), Amorepacific Group recorded its highest-ever sales for the event, with US sales up 20% YoY. LANEIGE Lip Glowy Balm and Lip Sleeping Mask ranked #1 and #2 in the lip balm category, and the COSRX Snail Mucin serum ranked #26 in all of Beauty & Personal Care.
facts.number: US sales +20% YoY; lip balm #1–#2; COSRX #26 overall BPC

facts.claim: COSRX ranked #1 in Amazon's beauty category in both Germany and the UK during the mid-2026 Prime Day period. It also posted its best-ever result at Qoo10 Japan Mega Wari and was named first-half #1 at the Qoo10 Mega Beauty Awards 2026.

On October 8, 2026, COSRX expanded direct shipping from its official global online store to about 200 countries. Shipping had previously been limited mainly to the US and Canada, and buyers in newly added countries get dedicated promotions and membership benefits. No sales figures were disclosed.

At Amazon Prime Big Deal Days (Oct 6–7, 2026), rival medicube (APR) said its US sales rose about 85% YoY and that 13 of its products made the US Amazon beauty top 100. No LANEIGE or COSRX figures for this event were found in public sources.
facts.number: medicube US +85% YoY; 13 products in top 100

facts.claim: LANEIGE launched a Sleeping Mask campaign with BTS's Jin on September 14, 2026, and says the Sleeping Mask line has sold more than 58.3 million units globally since its 2020 launch.

LANEIGE's limited-edition collaboration with Matin Kim, the 'Juicy Pop Box Lip Tint Monotune', is a pH-reactive tint that looks black and turns purple on the lips. It launched overseas first on September 1, then in Korea in October through Olive Young and other e-commerce channels. Separately, a Musinsa Beauty exclusive pre-launch was reported on October 12.

The National Pension Service reported a stake of 8.42% in Amorepacific in its March 17, 2026 filing. CEO Score Daily reported on October 15 that the stake has since reached double digits, but the exact figure was not confirmed.
Amorepacific Group's full-year 2025 results were ₩4.6232tn in revenue and ₩368.0bn in operating profit.

angles: Prepare for Black Friday by benchmarking on what is public: LANEIGE's October Big Deal Days figures are undisclosed, but medicube's are known (+85% in the US, 13 products in the top 100). Brands should plan hero-SKU depth in the lip category and lock in stock and coupons ahead of Black Friday and Cyber Monday, using LANEIGE's #1–#2 lip balm ranks at Prime Day as the reference point.

D2C playbook: COSRX now ships direct to about 200 countries, which lets it test demand in markets without distributors. Marketplace sellers and distributors should expect more price-gap and gray-market conflicts. Brands should consider a similar 'official store as anti-counterfeit' message for markets that have no local retail presence.

The margin story behind the growth: overseas OP grew 99% at a 13% margin, but BNK expects ad and promotion costs to cap leverage through 2027. Suppliers such as ODMs, agencies and 3PLs should expect pressure on marketing efficiency and unit costs instead of budget expansion.

Fashion crossover and channel sequencing for launches: the LANEIGE × Matin Kim tint launched overseas first, then in Korea via Olive Young and a Musinsa pre-launch. This is a model for indie brands pairing with fashion labels, using a pH-reactive tint for a novelty hook and bundled goods such as a duffel bag and pouch.

content.excerpt_ko: 2026년 2분기 아모레퍼시픽 해외 영업이익은 718억원으로 +99% 늘었고, 해외 매출 증가율 +28%의 3배가 넘습니다. 2분기 숫자를 끌어올린 건 프라임데이 립밤 1·2위였고, 하반기에는 코스알엑스 약 200개국 직배송과 BTS 진 캠페인이 이어집니다. 블랙프라이데이 전에 실무자가 챙길 포인트를 정리했습니다.
content.body_ko_html:
결론: 해외에서 '많이 판' 분기가 아니라 '남긴' 분기

2026년 2분기 아모레퍼시픽 해외 사업은 매출 5,516억원(+28%), 영업이익 718억원(+99%)을 기록했습니다. 해외는 1분기와 2분기 모두 두 자릿수 영업이익률을 냈습니다. 이익이 매출보다 3배 넘게 빠르게 늘었고, 이번 분기 핵심은 이 부분입니다. (CNC뉴스)

그룹 연결(아모레퍼시픽홀딩스) 기준 2분기 매출은 1조 2,543억원(+14.6%), 영업이익은 1,228억원(+53.3%)입니다. 국내도 매출 +10%, 영업이익 +48%로 영업이익률이 약 10%까지 올라왔고, 온라인과 MBS 채널이 각각 두 자릿수 성장했습니다. 비교 기준으로, 아모레퍼시픽그룹 IR 뉴스에 따르면 2025년 연간 그룹 실적은 매출 4조 6,232억원, 영업이익 3,680억원이었습니다.

다만 이 흐름이 계속된다고 단정하기는 어렵습니다. 스톡허브 요약에 따르면 BNK투자증권은 해외 영업이익률을 13.0%로 계산하면서도, 2027년까지 광고·판촉비가 영업 레버리지를 제한할 것으로 봤습니다. ODM, 에이전시, 3PL이라면 예산 확대보다 효율·단가 압박을 먼저 예상해 두는 게 맞습니다.

채널: 아마존 히어로 SKU + 공식몰 직배송

  • 인사이트 보도에 따르면 아마존 프라임데이(2026년 6월 23~26일)에서 그룹 미국 매출이 전년 대비 20% 늘었습니다. 라네즈 립 글로위밤과 립 슬리핑마스크는 립밤 카테고리 1·2위, 코스알엑스 스네일 뮤신 세럼은 뷰티&퍼스널케어 전체 26위였습니다.
  • 같은 프라임데이 기간 코스알엑스는 독일·영국 아마존 뷰티 카테고리 1위에 올랐습니다. 일본에서는 큐텐 메가 뷰티 어워즈 2026 상반기 1위를 받았습니다(CNC뉴스).
  • 10월 8일 코스알엑스는 글로벌 공식몰 직배송 국가를 미국·캐나다 중심에서 약 200개국으로 넓혔습니다. 신규 국가에는 전용 프로모션과 멤버십 혜택을 붙였고, 매출 수치는 공개하지 않았습니다(파이낸셜뉴스).

직배송은 총판이 없는 국가에서 수요를 테스트하는 장치입니다. 기존 셀러·벤더 쪽에서는 가격 갭과 병행수입 마찰이 커질 수 있습니다. 현지 리테일이 없는 국가라면 '공식몰 = 정품'이라는 메시지는 그대로 가져다 써도 됩니다.

블프 전 체크: 빅딜데이 숫자는 경쟁사만 공개

10월 6~7일 프라임 빅딜데이의 라네즈·코스알엑스 수치는 공개 자료에서 확인되지 않았습니다. 반면 에이피알 메디큐브는 미국 매출 약 +85%, 미국 아마존 뷰티 톱100에 13개 제품이 들어갔다고 밝혔습니다(MTN). 블프·사이버먼데이 기준점은 프라임데이 립밤 1·2위로 잡으시고, 히어로 립 SKU의 재고 깊이와 쿠폰은 미리 확정해 두시길 권합니다.

캠페인·신제품: 증거 숫자와 출시 순서

  • 이투데이 보도에 따르면 라네즈는 9월 14일 BTS 진과 슬리핑마스크 캠페인을 시작했습니다. 회사는 슬리핑마스크 라인이 2020년 출시 이후 글로벌 누적 5,830만 개 넘게 팔렸다고 밝혔습니다. 모델 파워 옆에 누적 판매량이라는 증거를 붙인 구조입니다.
  • 코스인코리아 보도에 따르면 마뗑킴 협업 한정판 '쥬시 팝 박스 립 틴트 모노튠'은 검정색으로 보이다가 입술에서 보라색으로 바뀌는 pH 반응 틴트입니다. 9월 1일 해외에서 먼저 출시했고, 10월에 올리브영 등으로 국내 출시했습니다. 10월 12일에는 무신사 뷰티 단독 선공개 소식도 나왔습니다.

인디 브랜드가 가져갈 포인트는 두 가지입니다. 첫째, 패션 협업 제품은 해외에서 반응을 먼저 확인하고 국내로 들여오는 순서. 둘째, 색이 변하는 제형처럼 한 장면으로 설명되는 훅.

지분 동향

국민연금의 아모레퍼시픽 지분은 2026년 3월 17일 공시 기준 8.42%였습니다. CEO스코어데일리는 이후 지분이 두 자릿수가 됐다고 보도했지만, 정확한 수치는 확인되지 않았습니다. 투자 판단이 아니라 참고용 정보입니다.

출처: CNC뉴스, 인사이트, 파이낸셜뉴스, MTN, 이투데이, 코스인코리아, 스톡허브, CEO스코어데일리, 아모레퍼시픽그룹 IR

이 리포트는 AI 도구의 도움을 받아 리서치·작성했으며, 편집자가 검수했습니다.

content.title_en: Overseas profit up 99%: can Amorepacific's margins hold through 2027?
content.excerpt_en: Amorepacific's overseas operating profit rose 99% to ₩71.8bn in Q2 2026, against 28% revenue growth. Prime Day lip balm ranks of #1 and #2 carried the quarter. For the second half, COSRX now ships direct to about 200 countries and LANEIGE has a campaign with BTS's Jin. Here is what to watch before Black Friday.
content.body_en_html:
The takeaway: a quarter of profit, not just volume

In Q2 2026, Amorepacific's overseas revenue grew 28% to ₩551.6bn, and overseas operating profit rose 99% to ₩71.8bn. Overseas margins were in double digits in both Q1 and Q2 (CNC News).

On a group consolidated basis, Amorepacific Holdings reported Q2 revenue of ₩1.2543tn (+14.6%) and operating profit of ₩122.8bn (+53.3%). Domestic revenue rose 10% and domestic profit rose 48%, for a margin of about 10%. Online and MBS channels each grew by double digits. For comparison, Amorepacific Group IR puts full-year 2025 group results at ₩4.6232tn in revenue and ₩368.0bn in operating profit.

There is a caveat. According to a StockHub summary, BNK Investment & Securities puts the overseas margin at 13.0% but expects ad and promotion spending to limit operating leverage through 2027. ODMs, agencies and 3PLs should prepare for pressure on efficiency and unit costs, not bigger budgets.

Channels: Amazon hero SKUs plus D2C reach

  • Insight reports that at Prime Day (June 23–26, 2026), the group's US sales rose 20% YoY. LANEIGE Lip Glowy Balm and Lip Sleeping Mask ranked #1 and #2 in lip balm, and the COSRX Snail Mucin serum ranked #26 in all of Beauty & Personal Care.
  • COSRX ranked #1 in Amazon beauty in Germany and the UK during Prime Day. In Japan, it was named first-half #1 at the Qoo10 Mega Beauty Awards 2026 (CNC News).
  • On October 8, COSRX expanded direct shipping from its official store from mainly the US and Canada to about 200 countries. New markets get dedicated promotions and membership benefits. No sales figures were disclosed (Financial News).

Direct shipping lets COSRX test demand where it has no distributor. For existing resellers, it may also mean more price-gap and gray-market friction.

Before Black Friday

LANEIGE and COSRX results for Prime Big Deal Days (October 6–7) were not public. Rival medicube said its US sales rose about 85% and that 13 of its products made the US Amazon beauty top 100 (MTN). Use the Prime Day lip balm ranks as your reference point, and lock in stock depth and coupons for hero lip SKUs early.

Campaigns and launches

  • Etoday reports that LANEIGE began a Sleeping Mask campaign with BTS's Jin on September 14. The company says the line has sold more than 58.3 million units globally since 2020, so the campaign comes with a proof number attached.
  • CosinKorea reports that the limited-edition Matin Kim collaboration, Juicy Pop Box Lip Tint Monotune, is a pH-reactive tint that looks black and turns purple on the lips. It launched overseas first on September 1 and arrived in Korea in October through Olive Young and other channels. A Musinsa Beauty exclusive pre-launch was reported on October 12.

Ownership note

The National Pension Service held 8.42% as of its March 17, 2026 filing. CEO Score Daily reported that the stake has since reached double digits, but the exact figure is unconfirmed. This is not investment advice.

Sources: CNC News, Insight, Financial News, MTN, Etoday, CosinKorea, StockHub, CEO Score Daily, Amorepacific Group IR

Researched and drafted with AI tools, reviewed by the editor.

slides.action: 해외 SKU별 공헌이익 점검, 광고비 대비 마진 낮은 SKU 정리

slides.headline: 프라임데이 립밤 1·2위
slides.why: 10월 빅딜데이 수치 비공개, 메디큐브는 미국 +85% 공개.
slides.action: 블프 전 히어로 립 SKU 재고 깊이·쿠폰 조기 확정

slides.headline: 코스알엑스, 200개국 직배송
slides.why: 총판 없는 국가도 공식몰로 수요 테스트 가능.
slides.action: 직배송 확대 전 국가별 가격 갭·총판 계약 조항 확인

slides.headline: 진 캠페인 + 누적 5,830만 개
slides.what: 9월 14일 BTS 진과 슬리핑마스크 캠페인 시작(보도 기준).
slides.why: 모델 파워에 2020년 이후 누적 판매량 증거를 결합.
slides.action: 모델 기용 시 누적 판매량 등 검증 숫자 함께 노출

slides.headline: 마뗑킴 틴트, 해외 먼저 출시
slides.what: 검정→보라로 변하는 pH 반응 한정 틴트, 9/1 해외 선출시.
slides.why: 10월 국내 올리브영 출시, 무신사 단독 선공개도 보도.
slides.action: 패션 콜라보는 해외 선출시로 반응 먼저 검증

slides.headline: Overseas sales +28%, profit +99%
slides.what: Q2 2026 overseas revenue was ₩551.6bn (+28%) and operating profit ₩71.8bn (+99%).
slides.why: Double-digit overseas margins in Q1 and Q2; profit grew 3.5x faster than sales.
slides.action: Expect brand pressure on unit costs and promo efficiency, not bigger budgets.

slides.headline: Prime Day: LANEIGE takes lip balm #1 and #2
slides.what: At Prime Day (Jun 23–26), LANEIGE lip balms reportedly ranked #1–#2; group US sales +20%.
slides.why: October Big Deal Days figures are undisclosed, while medicube reported +85% in the US.
slides.action: Lock Black Friday stock depth for proven hero lip SKUs early.

slides.headline: COSRX ships direct to ~200 countries
slides.what: From Oct 8, COSRX's official store ships to ~200 countries, up from mainly the US and Canada.
slides.why: COSRX can now test demand in markets that have no distributor.
slides.action: Distributors: check price gaps and exclusivity terms in your contracts now.

slides.headline: Jin campaign backed by 58.3m units sold
slides.what: LANEIGE reportedly began a Sleeping Mask campaign with BTS's Jin on Sep 14.
slides.why: The campaign pairs star power with proof: over 58.3m units sold since 2020.
slides.action: Feature the campaign hero SKU with the units-sold claim on shelf and in listings.

slides.headline: Matin Kim tint launched abroad first
slides.what: Limited pH-reactive tint that looks black but turns purple on lips; overseas launch Sep 1.
slides.why: It reached Korea in October via Olive Young, and a Musinsa pre-launch was reported.
slides.action: Retailers: ask brands for fashion-collab limited editions with overseas-first windows.
